title: fix(cli): os serve refuses to boot a standalone stack whose plugins lists an entry that may provide the crypto provider
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：栈的 `plugins` 里没有插件实例(没有带 `init` 的项)时，`os serve` 走 standalone 启动，不加载作者写的 `plugins` 项。现在若其中某项声明了加密提供者(`providesServices: ['crypto-provider']`)，或是无法导入的包名，则拒绝启动并点名该项；其它项照旧。
- **为什么改**：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `@objectstack/cli`(patch)。新会被拒绝的只有：这类栈里声明了 `crypto-provider` 的项、无法导入的包名。standalone 启动前会按一次性 secret 命令的同样方式读取(导入)这些包名以判断其声明，但不启动它们。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的 `refuseSetAsideCryptoProviderPlugins`，以及 `run()` 里 `if (useArtifactFallback || shouldBootWithLibrary(config))` 开头的那一次调用。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts`，预期 27/27 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位做 contract review 后落地。

## What changes

- **`os serve` refuses to boot a standalone stack whose `plugins` lists an entry that may provide the crypto provider.** A stack whose `plugins` lists no plugin instance boots the standalone stack, which does not load the authored `plugins` entries. The crypto provider (`crypto-provider`) seals every secret field, datasource credential and encrypted setting, so before that boot each authored entry is read for what it declares:
  - an entry that declares `providesServices: ['crypto-provider']` (ADR-0116) is refused, named, with the remedy (list the provider's plugin instance);
  - a package specifier that does not import declares nothing, and is refused through the existing `refuseUnloadedCryptoProviderPlugins`;
  - every other entry keeps today's handling.
- Each entry is read the way the boot loop and the one-shot secret commands read one: a string is imported host-anchored (`Serve.importConfigPlugin`), an object is read as it is. Nothing is wrapped, mounted or initialized.
- **New export** `refuseSetAsideCryptoProviderPlugins` beside `refuseUnloadedCryptoProviderPlugins` in `commands/serve.ts`. It throws the existing `HostCryptoProviderRefusal`.

A host config (any entry with `init`) and a stack with no `plugins` are unchanged.

## Why

QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)

## Verification

Readings are on `4a2a6d1d4`, one commit that has since been rebased onto `main` at `f8c3ecc42` as `eb1a33b4e`. No `packages/cli` file changed between the two bases, so the suite reading carries over. The derived gates and type-check debt were run on `eb1a33b4e`.

<details><summary>Pins, red-first and restore</summary>

- New `packages/cli/test/serve-set-aside-crypto-provider-plugin.integration.test.ts`: four real `os serve` boots (src, through `runServe`). Two are refused and name the entry and `crypto-provider`: a stack whose `plugins` is one specifier that does not import, and a stack whose `plugins` is one object declaring the provider. Two CONTROLs reach the ready banner on a bound port: an object declaring another service, and a stack with no `plugins`.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts`: four unit cases for `refuseSetAsideCryptoProviderPlugins`. They cover a specifier that does not import, a specifier importing a declaring plugin, and an object declaring the provider that is never initialized; the CONTROL is entries declaring other services or none, plus a missing or empty list. A source pin sits beside them: the check sits inside the standalone branch, before the authored list is replaced. 27 passed (27).
- Red-first: with `serve.ts` set back to its `main` blob, the integration file read 2 failed | 2 passed (4); the two refusal cases were red and both CONTROLs green. Restored to the same blob as the commit: 4 passed (4). The CLI runs from `src` here, so no rebuild sits between mutation and run.

</details>
